description: Chronodynamic Relativity Boltzmann Hierarchy Parameter Configuration and Physics Taxonomy
notes: Controls parameters for CLASS-CR and optimization scripts. Includes Option A (Physically bounded calibration & Silk damping) and Option B (Early ISW potential decay & Relativistic space-density lensing/refraction). Seeded from latest optimization basin.

H0.description: Hubble constant today in km/s/Mpc (Constrained by local distance ladder and SNe Ia: 70.5 ± 1.5 km/s/Mpc)

omega_b.description: Physical baryon density omega_b = Omega_b * h^2 (Constrained by Big Bang Nucleosynthesis AlterBBN D/H and 4He yields: 0.02237 ± 0.0005)

omega_cdm.description: Physical cold dark matter density (Strictly 0.0 in pure Chronodynamic Relativity from first principles)

n_space.description: Chronodynamic space density scaling exponent n = 3/(2*pi) in rho_s(t) propto a(t)^(-n)

A_s.description: Primordial scalar perturbation curvature amplitude at pivot scale k = 0.05 Mpc^-1

n_s.description: Primordial scalar spectral tilt index (Scale invariance with slow-roll inflationary tilt)

z_reio.description: Optical depth reionization redshift (Constrained by Planck low-ell EE polarization)

Y_p.description: Primordial helium mass fraction from AlterBBN CR nucleosynthesis

N_ur.description: Standard Model ultra-relativistic neutrino species effective degrees of freedom

has_neutrino_hierarchy.description: Flag for neutrino phase shift inclusion (1: enabled, 0: disabled)

sigma_lens.description: CMB gravitational/refractive lensing dispersion smoothing scale in multipole space

refract_amp.description: Chronodynamic spatial refraction / lensing power fraction (Option B)

psi_0.description: Primordial gravitational potential amplitude scale driving acoustic oscillations: Phi_init = - 2.42 * psi_0 * g_drive

beta_boost.description: Chronodynamic non-linear algebraic root acceleration boost mu_CR in early plasma

phi_0.description: Relativistic gravitational phase shift advancing acoustic peaks (delta_phi / pi)

l_drag.description: Baryon drag decoupling multipole scale controlling radiation-drag offset cutoff

gamma_d.description: Silk diffusion damping power exponent: silk = exp(-0.5 * (k/k_silk)^gamma_d)

c_dipole.description: Doppler velocity coupling amplitude for baryon-photon dipole (Fills acoustic troughs in quadrature with monopole)

c_drag.description: Baryon drag zero-point displacement coupling amplitude (Sets odd-to-even peak amplitude modulation)

y_cal.description: Planck instrument absolute calibration factor (Physically restricted to 1.00 ± 0.05, Option A)

A_ps.description: High-ell unresolved point source foreground amplitude in muK^2 (Planck PR3 empirical residual: 0 to 50 muK^2)

A_ISW.description: Early Integrated Sachs-Wolfe decay amplitude modifier (Directly boosts baseline across ell ~ 200 - 600, Option B)

ell_ISW.description: Multipole transition cutoff scale for Early ISW potential decay (Option B)

A_0.description: Base acoustic oscillation amplitude scale factor

ell_0.description: First acoustic peak target multipole from sound horizon theta_s = r_s / D_A
